research_notes: A cold-start successor should be able to determine whether the predecessor closed cleanly by inspecting immutable close evidence first.
If close evidence is absent, it should inspect the latest incremental batch and known scheduler state without fabricating a clean pass.
This conservative recovery path is compatible with disposable workers.
It also avoids requiring the predecessor to remain alive for acknowledgment.
The same durability principle will later simplify handoff fencing.
No current strict result is asserted before close.
